articles.title: Tidal Meniscus
articles.summary: Tight wet bead arcs and residue rings; glossy islands inside dull contact halos. A fine dotted wet-looking grain; individual discs vanish and the surface reads as a slightly bubbly, wet sheen.
articles.what: Wet islands recede inside contact arcs, leaving pinning points, beads and residue rings. Up close: Tight rows of round and oval drops about 25 px wide, each a glossy disc ringed by a dull halo, with tiny dark bead dots between rows. Like water spots or condensation beads in even rows. On metallic the discs are bright and clearly ringed; on satin they are softer. From a distance: A fine dotted wet-looking grain; individual discs vanish and the surface reads as a slightly bubbly, wet sheen. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: metal, roughness, clearcoat. Group: Liquid & Coating (Surface library tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.
how: Click a zone card and expand SPEC OVERLAYS.
Click + ADD SPEC OVERLAY, open the Surface library tab and the group "Liquid & Coating", or search for "Tidal Meniscus".
Click it, then click Add this overlay in the Inspect surface window.
Set Strength (default 50%) and tick the Metallic, Roughness and Clearcoat boxes you want.
Use Size and Rotation to make the texture finer, then render.
tips: Hood, roof, doors: flat panels get the best bead rows
Trim works but dots get small
Numbers stay readable; dots add mild texture, fine with bold numbers.
Soft glossy drop discs in the highlight, a wet beaded look on a flat surface
Pairs well with: gloss, metallic, matte.
pitfalls: Not dirt or water stain paint: shine only, no colour
Not Spray Coalescence: neat round drops with halos, not heart-shaped merged blobs
Avoid: can look like water damage, too subtle on dark matte.
articles.intent_note: A spec pattern changes the shine only: metal, roughness and clearcoat, never the paint colour.
articles.paint_advice: It cannot recolour anything. Metal added to a light paint looks bright; metal added to a dark paint stays dark, because metal reflection inherits the paint colour. Pair it with a paint that gives the gloss difference something to show on.

combos.why: Up to five overlays stack in order; a strong overlay can wash out the ones below it.
The blend mode decides how this overlay meets the base shine. Normal is the safe start.
Coat values 1 to 15 and roughness under 15 on non-chrome pixels are raised to safe values on export.

examples.title: Add it as an overlay
examples.goal: Layer Tidal Meniscus over a base finish.
examples.result: The shine of the zone gets this texture while the colours stay put.
